startup.stableProfileProcessCold: Pending: the collected fresh-profile samples do not satisfy the protocol definition.
startup.interpretation: Fresh-profile and warm-profile debug-packaged starts were effectively identical and slow on this reference run. Fresh-profile samples used a new WebView profile each time and are not the protocol's stable-profile process-cold measurement. No startup threshold was defined for this Batch, so these numbers are evidence, not a pass claim.

projectFacts.automatedContract: Git, Agent, and provider each execute once when all shell consumers mount; fresh remounts add zero calls; force, TTL, retry, and A/B stale-response cases passed.
projectFacts.pendingReason: Tauri v2 exposes window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke as a non-writable, non-configurable property in the packaged WebView. A source-free CDP wrapper could not count commands without adding build instrumentation, so zero was not reported as a measurement.

sessionFileCreatedToUpdatedMs.source: Read-only post-run aggregation of the synthetic persisted session JSON createdAt and updatedAt timestamps; this is not send-to-persistence latency emitted by the benchmark harness.

longTasks.observation: Every completed terminal path emitted multiple >50 ms long tasks. Peaks near terminal rendering were approximately 1.7 seconds with additional approximately 0.8 second tasks. The duration-only observer establishes correlation, not attribution to Markdown, math, or highlighting.
